notes: 你好 is said ní hǎo: two third tones in a row, so the first one rises.
叫 jiào falls sharply, then 小明 is said as one name.

clips.en: What do you want to drink?
notes: Two third tones in a row: 你 nǐ sounds like ní before 想 xiǎng.
什么 shénme is said quickly, and the 么 gets very light.

clips.en: The weather is very nice today.
notes: 很 hěn before 好 hǎo: two third tones, so 很 sounds like hén.
今天 and 天气 are short and run together at normal speed.

clips.en: I want to buy a cup.
notes: 一 becomes yí before the fourth tone 个.
个 is often said short and light, almost like ge.
哪儿 nǎr is one beat: the 儿 merges into the syllable.
Listen for 在 zài as a quick falling tone between two longer words.
几点 jǐ diǎn: two third tones in a row, so 几 sounds like jí.
Before a second-tone syllable, a third tone stays low and does not rise: 起 qǐ in 起床 qǐchuáng.

clips.en: Are you going to school tomorrow?
notes: 吗 is very light and short at the end of the question.
不 changes to bú before the fourth tone 是 shì: bú shì.
的 is very light: de.
妈妈 māma: the second 妈 is light and short.
谢谢 xièxie: the second 谢 is light and short.
对不起 duìbuqǐ: 不 is light here.
In 不知道, 不 is bù before the first tone 知 zhī.
吧 is light at the end: ba.
你 nǐ and 有 yǒu are both third tones, so 你 sounds like ní.
我 wǒ before 喜 xǐ: two third tones, so 我 sounds like wó.
喜欢 xǐhuan: the 欢 is light.
Listen for 学校 xuéxiào versus 学习 xuéxí: the first syllable is the same, the second is different.
一 becomes yí before the fourth tone 个.
三块钱 sān kuài qián: the numbers run together at normal speed.

clips.en: I am 20 years old this year.
notes: 二十 èrshí is said as one word, so 十 is short.

clips.en: Excuse me, where is the school?
notes: 请问 qǐngwèn: the third tone 请 stays low before the fourth tone 问.
了 is light and quick: le.
一 becomes yì before the third tone 本.
了 and 吗 are both light: le ma.
冷 lěng is a third tone, and 了 is light and short after it.
饭 fàn appears twice (饭店, 吃饭). The tone is the same: falling.
很 hěn before 好 hǎo: two third tones, so 很 sounds like hén.

clips.en: There are four people in my family.
notes: 四口人 sì kǒu rén: a fall, a dip, then a rise.
家 jiā is high and flat: 我家 wǒ jiā.
你 nǐ is a third tone before the high tone 妈, so it only dips.
妈妈 māma: the second 妈 is light and short.

clips.en: I want to drink a glass of water.
notes: 我想 wǒ xiǎng: two third tones in a row, so 我 sounds like wó.
一 becomes yì before the high tone 杯: 一杯 yì bēi.

clips.en: He is not at home; he is at school.
notes: 不在 bú zài: 不 changes to bú before the fourth tone 在.
学校 xuéxiào: a rise, then a fall.
很好 hěn hǎo: two third tones, so 很 sounds like hén.
这个 zhège: 个 is light and short.
我有 wǒ yǒu: two third tones in a row, so 我 sounds like wó.
哥哥 gēge: the second 哥 is light and short.
你 nǐ is a third tone before the high tone 今, so it only dips.
忙 máng rises, and 吗 ma is light.

clips.en: We are going to the shop tomorrow.
notes: 我们 wǒmen: 们 is light and short.
商店 shāngdiàn: high and flat, then a fall.
十八 shíbā: a rise, then high and flat.
岁 suì falls: 十八岁 shíbā suì.
请你 qǐng nǐ: two third tones in a row, so 请 sounds like qíng.
这儿 zhèr is one beat: the 儿 merges into the syllable.

clips.en: I did not go to school yesterday.
notes: 没 méi rises: 没去 méi qù.
昨天 zuótiān: a rise, then high and flat.
你喜欢 nǐ xǐhuan: two third tones in a row, so 你 sounds like ní.
面包 miànbāo: a fall, then high and flat.
呢 ne is light and short at the end.
做饭 zuòfàn: both syllables fall.
多少 duōshǎo: high and flat, then a dip.
钱 qián rises at the end.
我哥哥 wǒ gēge: 我 only dips before the high tone 哥.
开车 kāichē: both syllables are high and flat.

clips.en: Where do you want to eat?
notes: 哪儿 nǎr is one beat, with the 儿 merged in.
想在 xiǎng zài: 想 only dips before the falling tone 在.

clips.zh: 他是我的老师，也是我的朋友。
clips.en: He is my teacher, and also my friend.
notes: 也是 yě shì: 也 is a third tone before a fall, so it only dips.
朋友 péngyou: the last syllable is light.

clips.zh: 我在商店买了两件衣服。
clips.en: I bought two pieces of clothing at the shop.
notes: 了 le is light and quick after 买 mǎi.
衣服 yīfu: the second syllable is light.

clips.en: What time did you go to sleep last night?
notes: 几点 jǐ diǎn: two third tones, so 几 sounds like jí.
晚上 wǎnshang: 上 is light and short.

clips.en: It is too hot today; I want to drink water.
notes: 太热 tài rè: both syllables fall.
了 le is light at the end of 太热了.
中国人 Zhōngguó rén: high and flat, rising, then rising again.
你是 nǐ shì: 你 only dips before the falling tone 是.
都 dōu is high and flat; it means all and sits before the verb: 都喜欢.
电影 diànyǐng: a fall, then a dip.

clips.en: My younger brother is watching TV.
notes: 弟弟 dìdi: the second 弟 is light and short.
正在 zhèngzài: both syllables fall.
做什么 zuò shénme: a fall, a rise, then a light 么.
在 zài is a quick fall before the verb.
